course_name_original: Technology of Machining, Metrology and Product Design
course_name_en: Technology of Machining, Metrology and Product Design

learning_outcomes.text: To give students knowledge with methods of technology of machining.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of machining technology
Machine tools, automation of movements, tool changes, workpiece exchanges, other automation options
NC control - principles of manual programming and workshop programming
Machine programming, choice of strategy and expert systems
Advanced turning technologies, type technology, machines, tools for progressive turning
Multi-axis turning, multi-spindle turning, workpiece clamping in serial and mass production
Advanced milling technologies, machines, four and five-axis milling, progressive tools, pallet systems
Production of gears, production methods, possibilities of numerical machines, finishing of gears, advanced methods of production of other complex profiles - grooving, threads
Surface finishing, grinding and other technologies to achieve the highest quality and precision of surfaces
The role of metrology in society, quality control of production processes
Additive and hybrid production technologies
Assembly technology, applied ergonomics
Technological design of production processes and economics
Metrology - metering longitude, calibre, run-out.
Metrology - metering thread and tooth systém.
Theory cutting - metering force and temperature measuring.
Theory cutting - metering tool wear.
Automatization production workpiece - types machine and their technological possibilities.
Hand programming - assemblage NC programme for CNC lathe and for CNC milling machine.
Machining process planning - procedures and documents.
Mechanical programming - CAM systems, make-up of partprograms.
Cutting tools - material, cutting geometry, sharpening.
Economics of the cutting process - calculation boundary dues and opt. cutting conditions.
Consultation of semestral work.
Spec. technology - shaving, finishing cut method, production thread and tooth system.
Unconventional technology - segmentation and their technological possibilities. Assembly - fundamentals of segmentation construction according to assembly, assembly organization.
